title: Geo: Xi arrives in Washington
summary: A thin early edition for Geopolitics, with one story. Xi Jinping arrived for a three-day state visit, greeted by Trump at his plane, with AI rivalry and a newly extended trade truce on the agenda. This edition covers items published from 22:00 UTC on 23 September until collection at 01:02 UTC on 24 September; Iran, Tigray, the UN, Poland and Gaza are in the 23 September edition. Other items in the window lacked a second independent source. GDELT failed to fetch, ISW returned HTTP 403, Polymarket returned HTTP 451 and ReliefWeb was empty.

stories.headline: Trump greets Xi Jinping at plane as Chinese leader arrives for state visit
stories.dek: Xi Jinping began a three-day US trip with trade and AI competition at the top of the agenda.
tldr: Trump greeted Xi Jinping at his plane as the Chinese leader arrived for a state visit, the Guardian reported.
Al Jazeera described a three-day US trip and said Trump is betting on stabilising global relations.
BBC said AI superpower ambitions were taking centre stage, and CNBC reported Bessent said the US-China trade truce had been extended for two months as the visit began.

body.text: Trump greeted Xi Jinping at his plane as the Chinese leader arrived for a state visit, the Guardian reported.
Al Jazeera reported the arrival as the start of a three-day US trip and said Trump is betting on stabilising global relations.
BBC said AI superpower ambitions were taking centre stage as the two leaders met.
The economic track moved first: CNBC reported Bessent said the US-China trade truce had been extended for two months as Xi began the visit.

stories.whyItMatters: The visit bundles trade, technology and security into one negotiation: a truce extension eases near-term tariff risk for markets, while AI rivalry keeps chips and supply chains on the table. It is the day's clearest cross-vertical signal.
stories.editorNote: Headline-level wire coverage; outcomes of the talks had not been reported at the time of collection. The trade-truce detail is covered in Markets.
